item.text:
Implemented the reading list as a Next.js app. The home page separates books you’re reading from books you’ve finished, and the form adds a title, author, and optional notes. Each book has a shareable detail page with a copy-link button.

Books are saved to [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json). The app setup and filesystem requirements are in [README.md](/workspace/README.md).

Run it locally with `npm run dev`. The shelf is visible to anyone who can access the app, and anyone with a book’s link can view its details and notes. I didn’t run a build or test suite.
